summary.business_type: Free open-source developer tool (browser-based Mermaid diagram editor with in-browser WebGPU AI) — mono-page React SPA on Vercel
top_findings: CRITICAL: crawlable HTML shell deleted from production (commit d169dbf, 2026-10-06) — served body has zero headings/paragraphs; every JS-blind crawler (Google first wave, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, social) indexes nothing
HIGH: apex→www redirect is 307 Temporary instead of 301/308 permanent — host signal not consolidated
HIGH: rendered heading structure broken — one text-sm h1 with a button nested inside, zero h2/h3 in the entire rendered DOM
HIGH: 'no telemetry / no tracking' copy contradicted by mounted Vercel Analytics + Speed Insights; /privacy returns 404 while PRIVACY.md exists in repo and omits Vercel Analytics

HIGH (perf): 1.24 MiB brotli eager JS+CSS before first paint — 73% is statically-imported mermaid+CodeMirror; mobile lab LCP 15.4s; 19 Google Fonts requests per load (2 render-blocking, duplicated weight sets)
quick_wins: Restore crawlable shell from `git show d169dbf~1:index.html` (1 commit + deploy) — unblocks Content, GEO, citability and headings at once
Flip apex→www to 308 permanent in vercel.json (5 lines)
Add screenshot property to existing JSON-LD (assets already served 200) + move person sameAs into author
Regenerate og-image without version badge (current asset bakes v0.9.0; app is v2.1.0)
Delete src/index.css:1 @import → one render-blocking Google Fonts request removed

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt correct + declared sitemap (22/22 validation checks pass)
Canonical self-referencing, consistent across og:url / sitemap / JSON-LD
http→https 308 hops correct; real 404s (no soft-404 factory); clean 1-URL URL structure
HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP+COEP (WebGPU requirement)
hreflang correctly absent (documented decision; /fr/ is a real 404)
Valid WebApplication JSON-LD with %APP_VERSION% build substitution verified

findings.title: Crawlable shell removed from production HTML since 2026-10-06 (regression, not design)
findings.description: index.html:161 '<!-- Shell removed for dev -->' shipped to prod; body = boot splash + 12s fallback + noscript; zero h1/h2/paragraphs in raw HTML
findings.recommendation: Restore the <main class="shell"> block from git show d169dbf~1:index.html; gate by env in dev instead of deleting

findings.title: apex→www is 307 Temporary for a permanent host move
findings.description: curl -sSI https://mermaidstudio.net/ → HTTP/1.1 307 Location https://www.mermaidstudio.net/; not in vercel.json (Vercel domain settings)
findings.recommendation: Add vercel.json redirects block with has:host filter and permanent:true, or flip in Vercel domain settings

findings.title: Rendered DOM: one text-sm h1 (brand) with nested button, zero h2/h3
findings.description: render-home.json: only h1 is topbar brand with About button inside; 'Free Online Mermaid Diagram Editor' exists only in title/meta
findings.recommendation: App-root visible h1; demote topbar brand to div; remove button from heading; h2 for natural sections (port to Android app repo required)

findings.title: CSP Report-Only only
findings.description: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only observed; script-src 'self' would block inline bootstrap — hash or externalize before enforcing
findings.recommendation: Monitor reports, hash the inline bootstrap, then flip to enforcing

findings.title: HSTS lacks includeSubDomains/preload; sitemap lastmod hand-maintained and stale (27 content commits since 2026-10-04); /index.html 200 instead of 301; meta keywords + app-ads.txt ballast; meta description ~163 chars
findings.description: Vercel platform default HSTS; sitemap.xml:5; L1-L7 findings
findings.recommendation: HSTS includeSubDomains; wire lastmod to build (scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs prebuild); 301 /index.html→/; drop keywords + app-ads.txt; trim description

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Honest, self-contained meta description (158 chars, quotable)
JSON-LD featureList verified accurate against the codebase
Zero filler/AI-slop in all existing copy (filler_score 0, ai_pattern_score 0); deleted shell prose was good writing (FRE 47.4) — restore, don't rewrite
Genuine first-hand origin story exists in i18n (en.json:682)

findings.title: Effective content depth ≈ 0 (Critical, convergence with shell removal)
findings.description: Rendered visible text = ~116 word tokens, 100% UI labels, 0 prose paragraphs, 1 h1; fails homepage 500 / product 300+ floors
findings.recommendation: Restore the 185-word shell prose verbatim

findings.title: Privacy claims conflict with production code; no privacy page on-domain
findings.description: en.json:670 'no telemetry, no tracking' vs App.tsx:161-162 mounts Vercel Analytics + SpeedInsights; /privacy 404; PRIVACY.md omits Vercel Analytics disclosure
findings.recommendation: Publish /privacy from PRIVACY.md (amended: disclose Vercel Analytics); align copy to 'no accounts, local-first, cookieless analytics'

findings.title: French content unreachable at every URL despite bilingual positioning
findings.description: fr.json maintains 611 keys; src/i18n/config.ts:13 hardcodes lng:'en'; /fr/ 404; crawlers see zero French words
findings.recommendation: Either ship /fr/ with a rendered FR shell or drop machine-facing FR declarations (og:locale:alternate, inLanguage) until reachable

findings.title: All supporting/authority content exists but is unreachable or unlinked
findings.description: docs/ deploys to GitHub Pages but the property is not live (404/NXDOMAIN); CHANGELOG reachable only via Welcome modal; exactly 1 <a> in rendered DOM
findings.recommendation: Ship the docs property (fix CI runners), link docs/CHANGELOG/GitHub from shell footer

findings.title: Author identity invisible on-page (JSON-LD only); AI-citation passage structure absent
findings.description: JSON-LD author Jérémie Dufault never visible; meta author says 'MermaidStudio'; no definitional passage or heading-anchored sections in rendered DOM
findings.recommendation: Footer credit matching JSON-LD Person; restore definition passage + 2-3 h2 sections

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title 51 chars, keyword-rich, survives rendering; og:/twitter: complete with absolute URLs + alt + dimensions; favicon/apple-touch-icon live-verified 200
Page-type ALIGNED with SERP intent (tool page for tool queries — no blog pivot needed); UX call of updates-only welcome modal is defensible
Query-set SERP consensus is 10/10 tool-type results — the page type is right

findings.title: Heading hierarchy broken (from Technical H2) — drag on On-Page score
findings.description: One brand h1 with nested button; zero h2/h3 anywhere
findings.recommendation: Real app-root h1 + section h2s (app-repo port flagged)

findings.title: Site appears in 0 of 30 observed top-10 results for its own queries; GitHub repo ranks #7 for 'mermaid live editor alternative'
findings.description: DDG Lite transcript (Bing-backed proxy), 3 queries; comparison intent (7/10 listicles incl. trymermaid.app dedicated compare page) ceded to third parties
findings.recommendation: Restore shell h2 'an open-source alternative to the Mermaid Live Editor' framing; later a dedicated comparison section

findings.title: First-3-seconds rendered experience is a silent tool; trust/AI-safety answers click-gated (2 clicks, crawler-invisible); 400-700MB AI model cost disclosed only post-commitment
findings.description: visible-text.txt = 101 lines of UI labels; App.tsx:125-130 updates-only modal; en.json:257 cost disclosure panel-only
findings.recommendation: Always-visible one-line value-prop strip (rendered, crawlable): 'AI runs locally on your GPU — your code never leaves your machine' + footnote the model download size

findings.title: Meta description ~163 chars (truncation risk); obsolete meta keywords
findings.description: index.html:17,40
findings.recommendation: Trim to ~155; delete keywords

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid WebApplication JSON-LD — all Google-required properties present (name, applicationCategory:DesignApplication, operatingSystem:Any, offers price 0 USD)
isAccessibleForFree:true, browserRequirements accurate (JS + WebGPU), softwareVersion 2.1.0 build-substituted and verified, codeRepository + sameAs live
Correct type choice (WebApplication over SoftwareApplication — keeps browserRequirements semantics); Person author correct over fabricated Organization
Honest-omission policy in code (no fabricated aggregateRating/HowTo/FAQPage — compliant with quality gates)

findings.title: Recommended screenshot property missing while assets already ship
findings.description: screenshot-wide.png + screenshot-narrow.png are 200 on prod and referenced by manifest.json — absent from JSON-LD
findings.recommendation: Add screenshot array (ready-to-paste block in findings/schema.md, replace index.html:50-80)

findings.title: sameAs hygiene: person identities on app node; GitHub profile asserted nowhere
findings.description: LinkedIn on app sameAs; author.sameAs missing github profile
findings.recommendation: Move person links into author.sameAs; app sameAs = repo (mirrors codeRepository)

findings.title: No dateModified freshness signal
findings.description: Block lacks datePublished/dateModified
findings.recommendation: Optional %BUILD_DATE% placeholder extension in vite.config.ts appVersionHtmlPlugin

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS 0.04 lab — structural corroboration: boot splash is position:fixed, replaced not shifted
Vite advancedChunks config is correct (ai-webgpu 6MB correctly lazy); Brotli + immutable caching on all eager chunks; SW network-first docs (never stale HTML)
Canonical entry (www) is single-hop; COOP/COEP verified on document + assets

findings.title: Eager 4.67 MiB raw / 1.24 MiB brotli JS+CSS before first paint — 73% statically-imported mermaid+CodeMirror
findings.description: modulepreload census: 11 chunks; WorkspacePanel.tsx:5,7 → CodeEditor.tsx:2-7, PreviewPanel.tsx:4; drives mobile lab LCP 15.4s / FCP 9.1s / TBT 610ms; unused-JS 1,599 KiB
findings.recommendation: Dynamic-import @/lib/mermaid/core in PreviewPanel render effect (in-repo precedent: ai-webgpu); React.lazy CodeEditor + idle preload; verified falsifiable: modulepreload count 11 → ≤9, mermaid matches → 0

findings.title: Google Fonts triple-injection: 19 requests per load (2 render-blocking with duplicated weight sets)
findings.description: index.html:102 link + src/index.css:1 @import (duplicate weight set) + App.tsx:18-28 eager injection of 17 SUPPORTED_GOOGLE_FONTS
findings.recommendation: Delete src/index.css:1 @import; gate the 17-font injection behind actual font selection; keep crossorigin (COEP)

findings.title: No field data exists: origin below CrUX eligibility; GSC property not shared with service account (403 both forms)
findings.description: CrUX URL+origin+history all 404 (2026-10-29); lab numbers are the only instrument
findings.recommendation: Share sc-domain:mermaidstudio.net with pagespeed@home-22395.iam.gserviceaccount.com (Restricted); configure ga4_property_id; re-probe CrUX monthly

findings.title: Splash fade-out (8s) is dead code; apex entrants pay a 307 hop
findings.description: boot-splash-out keyframes defined, never applied (occurrence count 1); apex→www 307 adds a document hop for non-canonical entrants
findings.recommendation: Apply the fade at 8s; flip redirect to 308 (shared with Technical)

categories.name: Images
what_works: Post-mount layout integrity strong on desktop 1920 and mobile 375 — no overlap/clipping/horizontal scroll

findings.title: og-image bakes a stale v0.9.0 badge while app is v2.1.0
findings.description: md5-identical repo/CDN (52c0b89b26a04b3e46e9b5b0aad0406e) with fresh CDN Last-Modified — stale badge is in the source asset; inconsistent with JSON-LD 2.1.0 and og:image:alt promising a version badge

findings.title: og-image illegible at feed size, no tagline

Citable corpus that does exist is high-quality: 27-word definitional meta description, verified featureList, honest noscript

findings.description: Both 404 (Vercel NOT_FOUND); near-zero standalone impact for a 1-URL site but trivially cheap
findings.recommendation: Add public/llms.txt (tool summary, canonical URL, version, license, GitHub README link) bundled with the shell fix

findings.title: package.json entity fields missing (repository/homepage/description/author/license)

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes (shell + consolidation)
items: Restore crawlable shell from git show d169dbf~1:index.html into index.html (h1, 2 paragraphs, 5-item feature list, trust links) + verify: grep -c '<h1' on served HTML ≥1
Flip apex→www to 308 permanent (vercel.json has:host redirect block) — verify: curl -sSI apex → 301/308
App-root h1 'MermaidStudio — Free Online Mermaid Diagram Editor'; demote topbar brand; remove button from h1 (FLAG: port to MermaidStudio-App per cross-repo rule)
Publish /privacy from amended PRIVACY.md (disclose Vercel Analytics); align 'no telemetry' copy; link from shell + app footer
Share GSC property with service account (Restricted) — unlocks indexation + performance data

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: De-eager mermaid stack (dynamic-import @/lib/mermaid/core in PreviewPanel; React.lazy CodeEditor + idle preload) — verify: modulepreload ≤9, mermaid matches 0, PSI unused-JS <400 KiB
Google Fonts dedup: delete src/index.css:1 @import; gate 17-font injection behind font selection — verify: 1 Google CSS request per load
JSON-LD: add screenshot array + author.sameAs GitHub profile (replace index.html:50-80)
Regenerate og-image (no version badge, 1200x630 share card with tagline); re-capture manifest screenshots
public/llms.txt + package.json entity fields + scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs prebuild lastmod
Fix splash fade dead code (apply boot-splash-out at 8s); drop meta keywords + app-ads.txt; 301 /index.html→/; HSTS includeSubDomains
Ship the docs GitHub Pages property (verify self-hosted CI runners active) and link docs/CHANGELOG from shell footer

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Always-visible rendered value-prop strip: 'AI runs locally on your GPU (WebGPU) — your code never leaves your machine' + model-size footnote (survives shell fix; addresses AI-curious persona 4/10)
French strategy decision: ship /fr/ with rendered FR shell (611 keys ready) OR drop og:locale:alternate + inLanguage until reachable
Brand seeds: 2-min YouTube demo, Show HN, awesome-mermaid PRs, r/mermaid + adjacent subs, dev.to build-log
3 h2-anchored sections in restored shell area (What is / How it works / Privacy) for passage citability
Configure ga4_property_id for Tier-2 organic reporting; Author surface (footer credit matching JSON-LD Person); meta author fix

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Capture drift baseline (claude-seo run drift_baseline.py) after Phase 1-2 land — regression net for future deploys
Re-probe CrUX eligibility monthly (field INP/LCP become measurable once traffic qualifies)
Re-run the 3-query SERP check quarterly (site URL presence in top-20; listicle placements)
CSP: after quiet report window, hash inline bootstrap and flip to enforcing
Re-audit post-fix (expected: health score 51 → 80+ on shell+redirect+headings+privacy alone)
